info.description:
Complete and authoritative API collection for the V-MAS (Vehicle Management System) backend. All 9 controllers fully mapped.

### Auth Flow
1. Send any Login request under 1. Authentication.
2. JWT is auto-saved to authToken collection variable.
3. All requests inherit bearer token.

### Roles: ADMIN | CONTROLLER | DRIVER
### Response Envelope: { success, message, data }
